name: riffast
description: Riffast — Plataforma SaaS multi-rifero para organizar rifas y sorteos

scripts.setup:local: npm run db:local --workspace=@riffast/api && npm run db:migrate --workspace=@riffast/api && npm run db:seed --workspace=@riffast/api
scripts.start: export NODE_ENV=production && npm run db:migrate:deploy --workspace=@riffast/api && npm run db:seed --workspace=@riffast/api && npm run start --workspace=@riffast/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@riffast/shared && npm run build --workspace=@riffast/api && npm run build --workspace=@riffast/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@riffast/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@riffast/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@riffast/web
